evidence_quotes.quote: Four Documents, a Non-Citizen, and a Diplomatic Controversy: The Documentation of Identity in the Mid-Nineteenth Century

A forgotten diplomatic controversy centered on the claim to U.S. protection by a yet-to-be-naturalized citizen is analyzed to offer insights into the mid-nineteenth century understanding of the status and function of the documentation of individual identity.
